title: POV:

A hotel opened at the
bottom of the ocean.
subs: In 2034, LuxStay opened a hotel at the bottom of the ocean.
In twenty thirty-four, LuxStay opened a hotel at the bottom of the ocean.
Eleven kilometers down.
Every room has an ocean view.
The elevator ride takes four hours.
So does room service.
The pool is on the roof. It's the ocean.
Guests said the windows were too dark.
So the hotel turned on the lights.
The lights attracted fish.
Then bigger fish.
Then a whale moved into the lobby.
He won't leave. He says he was here first.
The whale left a one-star review.
"Too bright. Too many humans."
Too bright. Too many humans.
Now fish book most of the rooms.
They pay in shells.
The hotel is now rated 4.9 stars.
The hotel is now rated four point nine stars.
Humans are no longer allowed.

hook.say: This hotel just banned humans. Here's why.
